runtime/hex#

The native layer under encoding/hex: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under encoding/hex: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable hexadecimal boundary for encoding/hex. Backends must emit the canonical lowercase alphabet and decode only validated ASCII hex pairs.
